verdict_reason: Every helper the diff names exists as described, but the typed seed count is wrong and the catalogue omits several helpers this PR adds.

todos.issue: '-typed ... five addresses holding roles of all three address types' is wrong: typed-seed.js's TYPED_SEED has six entries and stub.js seeds all six for a '-typed' organisation.
todos.fix: Must: testing.md states the typed seed's size as typed-seed.js defines it, or describes it without a count. One way: 'six addresses holding roles of all three address types'.

todos.issue: The helper catalogue, which calls address-book-requests.js 'the one owner of the address book tests' set-up', leaves out helpers this PR adds: VALID_ADDRESS_RECORD (address-book-requests.js), UNITED_KINGDOM_PARTIES and ANY_COUNTRY_PARTIES (journey-handshake.js, lines 88-101), the new common/test-helpers/address-book-stub.js (STUB_SEED_ADDRESS_NAME, listedStubNames), and signInAndOpenAddForm and expectInDocumentOrder (fit/address-form.js, lines 196-219). Everything else in those files is listed, so a reader trusts the list as complete and would write a local copy of a helper that already exists.
todos.fix: Must: every exported helper of the files the catalogue lists is named in it, and the new address-book-stub.js file appears with its exports. One way: add VALID_ADDRESS_RECORD (the fields with STORED_ADDRESS's roles), UNITED_KINGDOM_PARTIES / ANY_COUNTRY_PARTIES, an address-book-stub.js entry, and signInAndOpenAddForm / expectInDocumentOrder in their sections.

todos.issue: Three small inaccuracies in the new helper lines: line 227 calls typeSelectStateOf 'the jsdom and Cheerio reader', but it takes a Cheerio $ only (list.test-support.js:82); line 228-229 'follows a address type tab's link'; line 211 names 'the Origin or Consignor tab' while line 140 and features.md call the tab 'Origin and Consignor' (the type is 'Origin or Consignor').
todos.fix: Must: typeSelectStateOf is described as the Cheerio reader, the article reads 'an address type tab', and the tab is called 'Origin and Consignor' throughout. One way: edit the three phrases in place.
